checks.check: a saved Clash earns completion + win + Era-first exactly once
re-saving the same result: XP gained 0
five retried requests: XP gained 0 additional
a loss and a tie earn completion, never the win bonus
a second Clash in the same Era earns no second Era bonus
a first Clash in a new Era earns the Era bonus once
a huge XP delta is refused by the check constraint (xp_delta between 1 and 1000)
a source type or reason outside the closed vocabulary is refused
a forged result id that is not a saved Clash awards nothing
abandoned or unsimulated games have no saved row and so earn nothing
nothing awards for rolling, holding, revealing, coach choice, links, sign-in or refresh
the ledger is the total: the profile equals the ledger sum and the curve's level
